review_conclusions: The original guard changes retain their exact added and deleted lines after merging the upstream seed and split-bound work.
The combined source contains both guards without changing either standalone implementation.
Normal finite-state arithmetic remains unchanged by these source edits. Runtime verification is recorded separately by the main reviewer.
retained_scope_limits: The particle guard rejects non-finite state fields at selected boundaries. It does not validate every physical parameter or prevent every overflow of finite operands.
The residual store rejects a non-finite proposed update and retains the prior cell value. It does not repair an already non-finite stored cell.
Counters are rejection/write-event counts, not estimates of corrected concentration cells or physical accuracy.
Rejected particle paths preserve earlier accumulated contributions; the code does not roll back a whole trajectory.
